What it is: The bearer key saved with the active model endpoint. NVIDIA API keys start with nvapi-.

Running locally: Same key works everywhere. Store it as an environment variable (NVIDIA_API_KEY) rather than pasting it into code.

rich.32c87b138c97.source:
Reaching the launchable and operating its gateway require separate credentials:

  • Launchable access. The browser session reaches the host.
  • Gateway authority. The gateway token authorizes JSON-RPC calls.

After launchable authentication, GET /api/agent returns the gateway token under agent.dashboardUrl. Leave the token field blank and let the probe fill it in.
rich.32c87b138c97.value:
存取可啟動執行個體和操作其閘道需要兩套獨立憑證：

  • 可啟動執行個體存取憑證。瀏覽器會話用於存取主機。
  • 閘道權限。閘道 token 用於授權 JSON-RPC 呼叫。

可啟動執行個體完成身分驗證後，GET /api/agent 會透過 agent.dashboardUrl 傳回閘道 token。請將 token 欄位留空，由探測工具自動填充。

rich.3fe781eb137f.source: The session key is all the client sends to identify a conversation. From that one string the gateway resolves the full session server-side before every call, so the client never has to ship the transcript itself. Distinct session IDs separate conversations. The gateway may also accept aliases, such as a short key and its canonical agent:<agent-id>:<key> form, for the same conversation.
rich.3fe781eb137f.value: 用戶端只傳送工作階段金鑰來識別對話。閘道在每次呼叫前，會根據這個字串於伺服器端解析完整工作階段，因此用戶端不必傳送對話記錄。不同的工作階段 ID 用來區分對話。閘道也可能接受指向同一對話的別名，例如短金鑰及其標準形式 agent:<agent-id>:<key>。

text.7b65aa343238.source:

      its terminal loopback. Cloudflare sends HTTP checks through the approved relay; its WebSockets
      try the launchable first and can recover through the relay. The probe shows the route without
      displaying the session value.
